name: dobe_join_smirk2
subject: huge muscular doberman made of glossy pink paint goo with yellow streaks, seen from behind at an angle, head in profile facing right, arm reaching forward, lower body melting into goo
desc: only the mouth changes, very slightly: the corner of its closed mouth curls up just a little into a faint, restrained sly smirk, subtle, not a grin. The eye stays hidden. Nothing else moves: same head, ears, body, arm, goo, size and position
